I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own 9 June post in #central-team. Pine Crossing's morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce the problem using the store login. Nothing later in the channel says whether it was fixed, and I told her that too.

The knowledge brain (gbrain) refused my search because its access token isn't linked to any member, so I didn't use it. Fixing that needs an admin on the brain host to run `gbrain auth rescope`. I found no account files for Marrow Agrisupply in the file share.
